did.unittitle: David Rockefeller papers, Office Files, Embarcadero Center

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The collection consists of David Rockefeller's copies of closing documents in the acquisitions of properties at Embarcadero Center in San Francisco, California and the associated transactions.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Expedited Access - Level 1 - File Level Access. All bound volumes remain in original storage boxes.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research in accordance with the terms of donation from the David Rockefeller Estate, January 2019. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.
